incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 - Canary regression detected for model text-gen-v2-canary in us-west-2. High error rate (>= 12%) on production prompt set. Paging OpsOnCall.

OpsOnCall: on it. paging Jason and Amelia. What's the observable impact? @Priya FYI.

Jason: I see the alert. Latency also spiking 3x for canary pods. Quick look at metrics: 95p latency from 80ms -> 270ms starting 17:12 UTC.

Amelia: thanks. Are customers seeing degraded outputs or just latency? any safety regressions?

Priya: a handful of requests returned truncated outputs / malformed JSON from function-calling tests. Putting sample logs here.

Priya: ```
2027-05-02T17:12:33Z [canary-1] ERROR decode_response: unexpected EOF while parsing JSON
2027-05-02T17:12:34Z [canary-2] WARN logits_scale: value out of expected range 1.47
2027-05-02T17:12:35Z [stable-5] INFO response_ok
```

Devon: that's helpful. I ran a quick compare of logits scaling on canary vs stable; canary shows larger variance and occasional NaNs. Possibly a kernel/quantization mismatch with the new runtime path.

Jason: can we confirm which kernel/quantization profile was picked on canary? run:

Jason: ```bash
redwoodctl logs --pod canary-1 --since 10m | grep quant
# or
redwoodctl describe model text-gen-v2-canary --json | jq '.runtime, .quant_profile'
```

Amelia: I ran the describe earlier: canary picked `int8-optim-v2` while stable is `fp16-default`. That implies the new path is using a quant profile we didn't fully vet for short-response prompts.

Priya: customer impact assessment: 3 enterprise customers (acct-23, acct-99, acct-dev) reported malformed JSONs in last 10 minutes. No data exfiltration. Rate ~0.3% of requests overall but 5-8% for the test promptset used in our canary evaluation.

OpsOnCall: marking impacted customers and notifying CS to open tickets and provide workaround: set model to stable or use `response_truncation: false` flag.

incident-bot: ACTIONS REQUIRED: 1) Pause canary routing 2) Pin stable 3) Collect kernel logs for analysis. Use `incident:` tag for related logs.

Jason: I'm pausing canary routing now.

Jason: ```bash
redwoodctl traffic set text-gen-v2 --canary 0%
# result: rapid decrease in canary requests
``` 

Amelia: I'll verify pinning and ensure rollback-safe. Running `redwoodctl pin-model` now.

Amelia: ```bash
redwoodctl pin-model text-gen-v2 --version v2.2-stable
# -> success: pinned to v2.2-stable
``` 

Devon: I'm collecting kernel traces and will drop into the incident channel when ready. Hypothesis list so far:
- H1: quantization profile int8-optim-v2 has a bug for short-context prompts -> causes decoding errors
- H2: recent runtime kernel selection change introduced a numeric instability on Ampere GPUs
- H3: upstream model weights packaging missing a scale table for int8 path (less likely)

Priya: adding timeline entries:
- 17:11:20 UTC - canary rollout completed (v2-canary tagged)
- 17:12:00 UTC - first errors observed in canary metrics
- 17:12:30 UTC - incident-bot fired P1
- 17:13:05 UTC - OpsOnCall paged and began triage
- 17:15:40 UTC - canary routing paused
- 17:16:10 UTC - stable pinned

Jason: I've asked Deploy-bot to run a quick diff between canary and stable inference outputs on our internal validation set.

deploy-bot: running output diff job id 9876. sample summary:
- 1000 prompts: canary produced 67 malformed JSONs, stable produced 2
- average token-level KL divergence increased by 0.22 in canary
- hallucination score (heuristic) up by 18% on canary

Amelia: That diff is consistent with H1/H2. Next immediate tasks: keep canary out of traffic, preserve canary pods for debugging (don't evict), and gather full artifact list for the canary image and runtime config.

Devon: dumping canary pod env and package list:

Devon: ```
# canary-1 env
RUNTIME=redwood-rt-1.9.2
QUANT_PROFILE=int8-optim-v2
CUDA=12.1
CUDNN=8.9
MODEL_PACKAGE=text-gen-v2@v2.3-canary
``` 

Priya: checking model package checksum against build artifacts.

Priya: ```bash
sha256sum model/text-gen-v2_v2.3-canary.tar.gz
# expected: 9f2a... got: 9f2a... (match)
``` 

Jason: checksum matches. That reduces likelihood of corruption in weights (H3 less likely).

Amelia: I'll prepare rollback notes and comms for SRE/CS. Proposed mitigation timeline:
- 17:20 UTC - confirm all canary traffic 0% (done)
- 17:22 UTC - pin stable (done)
- 17:25 UTC - notify customers and CS with suggested workaround
- 17:30 UTC - begin deep-dive on quant kernel behavior

OpsOnCall: CS notified. Tickets created: INC-5234, INC-5235, INC-5236.

incident-bot: NOTE: preserved logs labeled incident:1793456789. All pods marked do-not-evict until postmortem.

Devon: sharing kernel traces snippet: 

Devon: ```
# trace excerpt
kernel_select: use int8_conv_v2
conv_v2: workspace 0x7fae... allocation failed -> fallback to generic
tensor_scale: nan at index 2048
```

Priya: interesting: fallback to generic then NaN. Could be an allocator race or uninitialized memory read in the custom int8 kernel.

Jason: next actions: assign root cause owners.
- Runtime: Devon + Jason -> reproduce NaN locally and add guard
- Model packaging: Priya -> verify any quant metadata differences (done)
- Rollout process: Amelia -> add pre-checks for quant paths in canary rollout

Amelia: adding actionable postmortem checklist now: create tests to validate int8 kernels on short response prompts, add canary-health check for malformed JSON > 0.5%, block canary if quant profile differs from stable without explicit test signoff.

Priya: putting a temporary query to surface other canaries using int8-optim-v2:

Priya: ```sql
SELECT model, env, quant_profile FROM deployments WHERE quant_profile='int8-optim-v2';
```

Priya: result -> only text-gen-v2-canary in us-west-2. No other live risk.

Jason: I'm drafting RCA thread for postmortem. Key points to capture: timeline, diff output, logs (kernel allocation + NaN), hypotheses and why H1/H2 more likely than H3, mitigation actions, action owners and due dates.

Amelia: I'll follow up tomorrow with a proposed safeguard to gate quant-profile changes behind a runtime canary stage with synthetic prompt set that covers short JSON outputs.

OpsOnCall: handoff to morning oncall @Evan. Evan, full notes in incident doc. No active traffic on canary. All mitigations applied.

Evan: ack. I'll take it from here and continue the RCA. Thanks team. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: canary routing paused and stable pinned. Severity downgraded to SEV2 for follow-up RCA tasks. Logs retained under incident:1793456789

Amelia: adding follow-up tasks in the #postmortems board: ensure quant test coverage, runtime guard, rollout policy change, CS/customer follow-ups.

Devon: I'll open PR with a runtime guard and unit-tests against NaN in int8 path. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1428

Priya: will draft customer-facing postmortem note for CS review.

Jason: thanks all. Closing thread once RCA doc is linked.

Amelia: RCA doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/1793456789-rca-draft (internal).
